limitations: Chronological validation is a retrospective check; this historical period was already used for earlier strategy research and is not an untouched prospective holdout.
Historical index bars are causal by bar end, but historical fetch/arrival latency cannot be established for every repaired index bar.
A missing 09:30 Nifty bar on 18 September invalidates seven order feature windows; all new vetoes preserve the approved baseline for those orders.
Breadth uses dated archived F&O futures, not cash-stock breadth; require 150 names and 90% timely snapshot coverage. Missing features preserve the approved baseline decision.
60-session reference uses at most available prior sessions, with actual n reported; there are fewer than 60 prior sessions in this source.
No historical VIX/options skew/sector membership/orderbook/event calendar/cross-stock correlation was fabricated. Their absence is reported.
Daily drawdown is based on closed-day PnL, not intraday mark-to-market. Existing fill paths and costs are inherited; gates precede portfolio reallocation.
Candidate thresholds are research assumptions. No policy is deployed or advertised as preventing all losses.

rules.rule: Approved G6 Nifty futures: reject only when slot and session both oppose
Also reject: 15-minute Nifty move opposes by >0.10% and price is adverse to futures VWAP
Also reject: >60% of covered F&O futures oppose from open and Nifty 15-minute move opposes
Also reject: breadth moves >=10 percentage points against side in 15 minutes and Nifty 15-minute move opposes
Also reject: Nifty session direction opposes and 15-minute move opposes by >0.05%
Also reject: 30-minute trend efficiency <0.25 (six completed returns required)
Also reject: efficiency <0.25 and same-clock realized volatility >1.25x prior-20-session median
Also reject: same-clock realized volatility >1.50x prior-20-session median
Also reject: at least three futures session-VWAP sign crossings during last 30 minutes
Also reject: Nifty extends in trade direction >2 times mean true range of last 14 five-minute bars from VWAP
Also reject: volume <0.70x prior-20-session same-clock median and efficiency <0.35
Also reject: >=3 of Bank, Financial, Midcap and Next50 futures oppose in both session and 15-minute returns
